overall_summary: Bitcoin holds near 64,000 with modest ETF inflows as volatility persists. Rising Treasury yields and the upcoming FOMC meeting are tempering risk appetite, while mixed signals from US-Iran developments add to the cautious tone for crypto traders today.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Modest Inflows on June 12
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a net inflow of about 86 million dollars and 1,350 BTC on June 12 according to CoinGlass data. This follows several days and weeks of heavier outflows that pressured prices lower earlier in the month. Traders should watch these flows closely as they signal institutional demand or lack thereof and often move the spot price directly.
items.impact: Small positive flow may provide minor support but unlikely to reverse recent pressure alone.

items.title: SpaceX IPO Debut Draws Market Focus with BTC Holdings
items.summary: SpaceX began trading on Nasdaq after raising 75 billion dollars in what is billed as one of the largest IPOs ever. The company disclosed holdings of roughly 18,700 Bitcoin worth over a billion dollars at current prices. Crypto traders are monitoring whether IPO-related liquidity shifts or profit rotation could influence Bitcoin and broader risk assets in coming sessions.
items.impact: IPO debut and associated liquidity moves could add short-term volatility to Bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin Trades Near 64,000 Amid Market Volatility
items.summary: Bitcoin hovered around 63,500 to 64,100 dollars on June 12 showing modest gains in some sessions after earlier weakness. Broader equities and the SpaceX listing appeared to influence sentiment. Traders care because sustained moves above or below key levels like 60,000 or 65,000 often trigger further positioning and liquidations.
items.impact: Range-bound action keeps near-term direction uncertain pending clearer catalysts.

items.title: US Jobless Claims Rise to 229K, Labor Market Resilient
items.summary: Initial unemployment claims increased by 4,000 to 229,000 for the week ending June 6, slightly above some forecasts but pointing to a still solid labor market. The four-week average held near recent lows. Traders watch this as an early signal on employment strength ahead of next week's Fed meeting, which could influence rate path expectations and risk assets like Bitcoin.
items.impact: Mild support for USD and yields, limited direct crypto impact.

items.title: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Climbs to 4.49 Percent
items.summary: The benchmark 10-year yield rose 2 basis points to 4.49 percent on June 12 amid ongoing inflation concerns and steady growth data. Higher yields typically pressure risk assets and support the dollar. Crypto traders monitor this as a gauge of tighter financial conditions that can weigh on speculative flows.
items.impact: Pressure on Bitcoin and equities from higher borrowing costs.

items.title: DXY Holds Near 99.75 as Markets Await FOMC
items.summary: The US dollar index traded around 99.75-99.78 with minor moves on June 12-13. Focus shifts to the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, the first under new Chair Kevin Warsh, where no rate change is expected but tone on inflation and projections matters. A stronger dollar often correlates with crypto weakness.
items.impact: Potential volatility in BTC if dollar strengthens post-meeting.

items.title: Markets Brace for Kevin Warsh's First FOMC Meeting
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's June 16-17 policy decision is Kevin Warsh's debut as chair, with rates seen staying at 3.75 percent. Analysts expect possible shifts in forward guidance or dot plot amid sticky inflation. This sets up key signals for rate trajectory into year-end, directly affecting crypto sentiment via liquidity expectations.
items.impact: High volatility likely around announcement for risk assets.

items.title: Trump Claims US-Iran Deal Near to End War
items.summary: President Trump announced that a deal has been reached or is very close to end the conflict with Iran, potentially including a 60-day ceasefire extension, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and releasing frozen Iranian assets. Iranian officials say no agreement is finalized yet and caution against speculation, with possible signing in Europe soon. Traders should watch this closely as it directly impacts global oil flows and risk sentiment.
items.impact: Potential de-escalation could ease oil prices and support risk assets including Bitcoin.

items.title: Explosions Reported Near Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Multiple explosion-like sounds were reported near Qeshm and Sirik in southern Iran on June 13, with speculation of maritime activity or drone incidents in the vital oil shipping lane. This comes amid ongoing US-Iran talks. Traders should care because any disruption here threatens 20 percent of global oil supply and spikes energy prices.
items.impact: Heightened risk of oil supply shocks and volatility in energy markets.

items.title: Iran State Media Details Potential US Deal Terms
items.summary: Iranian reports outline a possible interim deal that would lift sanctions, restore frozen assets worth billions, keep Hormuz shipping open, and involve US troop repositioning. Tehran stresses conditions like ending Lebanon fighting and warns its 'sword will always hang over' the strait. This keeps markets on edge over energy security and sanctions relief.
items.impact: Mixed signals could drive short-term volatility in oil and crypto as clarity emerges.

items.title: Iranians Divided on US-Iran Peace Prospects
items.summary: Public reaction in Iran is mixed as officials signal closeness to an interim ceasefire agreement with the US to halt months of conflict. Some see relief from sanctions and war, others remain skeptical amid ongoing tensions. This development matters for traders because resolution in the Middle East often triggers broader risk-on moves across assets.
items.impact: Positive resolution could boost global risk appetite and lower safe-haven demand.
